thread:
Sofia: Quick q — planning to start my 12-week parental leave on May 15. Need to coordinate coverage + a soft remote transition for the first 2 weeks back. What paperwork do I need to file and what should I include in the handoff? cc @Raj @people-ops-bot :smile:

Raj: Huge congrats! :tada: For coverage let's do: 1) a one‑page handoff, 2) oncall README + escalation list, 3) named backups for critical tasks. I'll book a 30m handoff 1 week before leave starts. Also check with People Ops re: payroll cutoffs and top‑up pay.

Dina: Hey Sofia — congrats! :heart: Short checklist from People Ops: LOA (leave of absence) form, short‑term disability claim (if using), benefits enrollment change (if adding dependents), manager coverage signoff, and payroll notice. Try to submit LOA ~30 days before start if possible. Internal links: https://benefits.redwood/leave and https://intranet.redwood/templates/handoff (templates are in the drive). PeopleOpsBot will DM the forms.

people-ops-bot: Automated message — LOA form: /forms/leave, Handoff template: /templates/handoff_md, Payroll cutoff for May 15 start: May 1. If you need top‑up pay, submit ST‑Disability + TopUp form no later than payroll cutoff.

Emily: I can cover week 2 of your rotation while you're out and be the oncall buddy for week 1 back. Happy to pair on the handoff doc this week.

Jake: Quick Q — does the 12 weeks run concurrently with PTO or is PTO separate? i.e., can I use PTO for part of the leave so it’s paid?

Dina: You can elect to run PTO concurrently with your leave (so you receive pay from PTO first), or save PTO for after your leave. If you want Redwood to top up state disability, fill the TopUp form and ST‑Disability claim. We'll include exact dates/payment in the LOA confirmation.

Raj: Also note: if you need a phased return or working remotely for an extra week, we generally approve up to 2 weeks of remote work as a transition — indicate that in the LOA request and we'll document it.

Sofia: Thanks — I'll submit the LOA today and drop a draft handoff in the people‑ops handoffs folder. Putting the handoff outline here so people can comment:

```
- Summary of ongoing projects
- Critical oncall runbook + who to page
- Key contacts (internal + customer) with slack/email
- Status of active PRs and blockers
- Weekly calendar for the next 6 weeks
- Post‑return tasks and suggested owner
```

Sofia: tagging @Emily and @Raj — thanks for covering, will ping you both when draft is up. :pray:

Dina: If you want, I can review the draft handoff and confirm payroll/top‑up details after you submit LOA.

Sofia: Perfect, will do. Appreciate the help everyone! :sparkles:
